summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments on the phase-39 branch (PR #423), which covered user-configurable vault parameters.
summary.outcome: All 6 actionable review comments were fixed (retention-days validation, TEE enrollment, useBin retention source, setTimeout leak, new IPNS keypair tests, and docs update), tests pass, typecheck is clean, and the branch was merged up from main with conflicts resolved.

repo: The `docs/phase-38-context` branch had a fix (commit 560c871fe) removing a circular `@cipherbox/core` import from vault-ipns.test.ts that was never merged into docs/phase-39-context — the fix had to be manually ported.
TEE key wrapping before IPNS publish follows the StorageTab.tsx pattern: fetch teeKeys from useTeeStore, wrap with tee public key, then pass encryptedIpnsPrivateKey and keyEpoch into the record.
STATE.md is maintained manually in .planning/ and gets clobbered on merge from main since main doesn't have in-progress phase updates — must be restored after each merge.
Retention days validation in packages/core/src/vault/settings.ts was blocking 0 as a value; D-03 requirement explicitly allows 0 (no retention limit).

useBin.ts was refactored on main to use getSdkClient().purgeExpired() (SDK-level call) rather than inline logic — the phase-39 branch had diverged and needed to adopt this pattern while also sourcing retentionDays from vault settings store.

code.finding: Retention days minimum validator was incorrectly rejecting 0; fix allows 0 per D-03 spec.
createAndPublishIpnsRecord call was missing TEE key wrapping — must wrap IPNS private key with TEE public key and persist encryptedIpnsPrivateKey + keyEpoch.
retentionDays was sourced inconsistently; should always come from vault settings store, not a local default.
setTimeout for debounce/feedback was not cleaned up on unmount — fix uses a ref to track the timer ID and clears it in a useEffect cleanup.
Pre-existing @cipherbox/core circular import caused test file to fail to resolve; fixed by inlining test vectors directly, matching the approach from the phase-38 fix commit.

New test file created for deriveVaultSettingsIpnsKeypair — isolated from vault-ipns.test.ts to avoid the pre-existing import resolution issue; 5 tests covering determinism, domain separation, and output shape.

workflow: When a sibling branch has a fix that wasn't merged, check git log on that branch and manually port the fix rather than fighting the test failure repeatedly.
Stashing in-progress review fixes before merging main is the right approach; git stash pop after resolving conflicts lets the fixes apply cleanly on top.
Running pnpm lint:fix before committing caught ESLint issues that would have failed CI — worth running before every commit on this repo.
GraphQL reviewThreads query via gh api is the reliable way to fetch unresolved PR threads; the REST comments endpoint misses thread resolution state.

friction: vault-ipns.test.ts had a pre-existing circular import failure (@cipherbox/core) that wasn't obvious until tests were run — wasted several tool calls diagnosing it before finding the phase-38 fix commit.
The phase-38 fix commit (560c871fe) was on a sibling branch but never merged into phase-39, causing a false test failure that looked like a new problem.
Merging main overwrote STATE.md with stale phase-38 data, requiring manual restoration of phase-39 progress state.
The user interrupted mid-commit to run pnpm lint:fix separately, indicating the workflow should include lint:fix before staging files.
Three-way conflict in useBin.ts required understanding both main's SDK refactor and the branch's vault-settings store change simultaneously.
open_items: Thread 5 (VaultTab.tsx:203 — presets not implemented) was marked Not Applicable as a deliberate simplification; presets feature is deferred for a future phase.

The vault-ipns.test.ts deriveRegistryIpnsKeypair domain separation test that previously depended on @cipherbox/core initializeVault may need to be revisited to ensure full coverage is maintained with the inlined test vectors approach.
No E2E tests were run (only unit + typecheck) — if VaultTab or vault-settings.service changes affect user flows, E2E coverage should be verified.
